# Tactus-in-a-Nutshell: Add Model primitive + train/eval CLI references

## Seed Findings

- chapters/04-primitives-reference.qmd: no Models section (missing what can I call from Lua coverage for Model).
- chapters/14-cli-reference.qmd: missing tactus train and tactus models evaluate.

## Deliverables

- Add Models section to primitives reference:
  - declare
  - Model("name") lookup
  - call pattern + output extraction (result.output or result)
  - brief mocking note
- Add CLI reference entries:
  - tactus train <file> --model <name>
  - tactus models evaluate <file> --model <name> [--candidate ...]

## Acceptance

- Nutshell supports quick lookup for Model usage + train/eval commands.
